Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
>>Can anyone who has done the entire GenCon US thing before provide something remotely like details? <<

Accommodations are very difficult to obtain at GenCon. It is a
well-attended conference but there are few large hotels in the downtown
Milwaukee area. The past couple of years, I have actually driven from
Chicago to Milwaukee and back on the days I've attended.

Last year, the folks from my gaming store got a room (like about 4 to 1
room) and that room was quite a distance away from the center (a taxi
ride away). I have also understood that Wizards actually buys up a
large quantity of hotel rooms in the greater Milwaukee area, which
further reduces supply.

I'm afraid I can't offer much more info than that.

Madman

Messages.Author: Bruce A. Carson
Messages.Body:
In order to get accomodations in downtown Milwaukee for an event you have to
go through the "Greater Milwaukee Convention and Visitors Bureau". They
dole out rooms using a lottery system - sometimes you get one downtown,
othertimes you get one out in the boonies and have to take a shuttle bus
into town.

If you don't go through the GMCB, you *may* be able to get a hotel room, but
at "full" price (often $250+ / night).

Another option is to rent an automobile and get a hotel/motel room at one of
the airport hotels. These are relatively cheap ($40-$60 / night). The only
downside is their distance and the fact you can't get one if the State Fair
is being held the same week as the Con...by the way - it IS the same week as
the con this year (Aug 3 thru Aug 13).

You can get more info at:
www.milwaukee.org

Bruce

I just received the Gen*Con Pre-reg book. Under "Where to Stay" (pg 65)
it has the following:

To receive a housing application form you
must first register for the show. When your
registration has been processed, you will
be mailed a confirmation letter and a blue
housing form. You must fill out that form
and mail it back to Wizards of the Coast for
processing.
Prior to May 1, all housing forms are to
be sent to Wizards of the Coast Event
Management for registration verification.
The forms are then sent to the Housing
Bureau in Milwaukee for assignment.
Hotels are assigned based upon room
availability. Due to the size of Gen Con and
the number of other citywide events, all
housing applications must be processed
through the Housing Bureau.
After May 1, all housing applications are
to be sent directly to the Milwaukee
Housing Bureau. All registered and non-
registered applications will be taken at this
time. Due to the high demand and limited
availability of downtown hotel space, we
encourage everyone to register early.
Historically, only the dorms are left after
May 1.
